# SOURCE: TinyStories, 1,000 stories

- URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/roneneldan/TinyStories (Eldan and Li, 2023, https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.07759)
- Fetched: 2026-11-14 via https://datasets-server.huggingface.co/rows?dataset=roneneldan/TinyStories&config=default&split=train&offset=0..900&length=100.
- Licence: CDLA-Sharing-1.0 (`license: cdla-sharing-1.0` on the dataset card; https://cdla.dev/sharing-1-0/). Sharing licence: keep this folder separate with this note; an importer must carry the licence with anything derived from the data. The stories are machine-generated text.
- Subset: first 1,000 rows of the `train` split as `stories-1000.jsonl`, `{id, text}`, id = `tinystories-train-<row_idx>`. No other change.
